groups.name: International Maritime Organization
groups.desc: The United Nations specialised agency responsible for the safety and security of shipping, and for preventing marine and atmospheric pollution by ships. IMO's work supports the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

items.name: IMO Publishing
items.desc: Over 200 titles in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese and Russian. The publications catalogue lists all titles in printed and electronic format, and book code lists are available for easy reference. Prices are subject to change without notice.

items.name: IMO web account registration
items.desc: Public registration for an IMO web account.

groups.name: International Labour Organization
groups.desc: The only tripartite UN agency. Since 1919, the ILO has brought together governments, employers and workers of 187 member States to set labour standards, develop policies and devise programmes promoting decent work for all women and men.

items.name: International Labour Organization
items.desc: Labour standards, policies and programmes for decent work.

items.name: Maritime Labour Convention, 2006
items.desc: The ILO convention setting seafarers' rights to decent working and living conditions.
